@Viraj Kansara , the count is available from the Platform DB. It is not a Secure search. Join workview.WorkItemDeaggregationRequest to workview.WorkItemDefinitionGenerationRequest on RunId and aggregate on Failed.

Running that against THD for 1 August onward returns one definition with real deaggregation failures. Markdowns returns none.

Read that carefully, because it splits the customer's question in two.

Work items that failed during generation are countable. The query above finds them. Four across two days so far, and none of them are the ones Ericka reported.

Work items that generate cleanly and then fail when a user opens Events are not countable from the database. They leave no failure record. Work item 248159 is in this second group, and it is the group the customer is actually asking about.

So I can give Valerie a number for the first group today. I cannot give her a number for the second group until we know what fails at query time. That is the honest answer to give THD.

2. Correction. The work item itself is not damaged

Corey asked on 1 September whether we can regenerate the IDs that hit this error. The evidence does not point there. Work item 248159 generated cleanly, deaggregated cleanly, and stored correct parameters. There is no damaged artifact to regenerate.

I am not ruling regeneration out. We should not offer it to the customer until we know what fails.

3. Environment and steps to reproduce

Environment: USPROD, client 85, C085_THD.

Reported by Ericka Smith on 1 September at 15:20, Canada Field Team.

THD (085), work item 248159, customer report

  1. Open work item 248159. Header shows MD03-APS-D, Consecutive Markdowns for Same Payment Card. Period 08/27/2026. Priority High.

  2. Header metrics read Value Potential 0.00 and Unique Count of Appriss Secure ID 3. Filters read Region 0032-CANADA, District 0157-CHARL, Store Number 7135, Cashier LDAP DXM6269.

  3. Open Events.

Expected: the Transactions panel lists the underlying transactions.

Actual: the Transactions panel is empty and the page returns "There has been a system error. Please contact support." Tracking code 774fbb98-fc34-4cd0-8ee8-538f85d2967d. Screenshots on the ticket from Ericka, 1 September 15:20.

Support attempt, 2 September

I could not reach the work item from my side. Two of the steps produce findings, so I am recording them.
